text: Priya delivered a Clinical Notes Summarizer that reduced physician documentation time by 38%. She integrated spaCy and PyTorch Lightning, fine‑tuned a BioBERT model, and set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions. The system was production‑ready within six weeks and exceeded our accuracy target (92% F1).

The product recommendation engine Priya built leveraged a hybrid RAG approach with Elasticsearch and a TensorFlow transformer. It boosted click‑through rates by 12% and scaled to 2 M daily users without latency spikes. Her clear documentation and Docker‑Compose deployment made onboarding painless.

Phase 1 of the Document Analyzer was a hit. Priya used Tesseract OCR plus a custom layout‑aware BERT model, achieving 87% entity extraction accuracy on lease agreements. The MLOps pipeline on Azure ML cut model retraining time from 4 hours to 45 minutes.

In Phase 2 Priya added a multimodal component for floor‑plan images. The vision model (ResNet‑50) performed well, though initial false‑positives on low‑resolution scans required extra data cleaning. Overall, the system delivered a solid 81% end‑to‑end accuracy.

Phase 3 introduced a conversational UI powered by LangChain. Users could ask natural‑language questions about property clauses and receive instant answers. Priya’s careful prompt engineering kept hallucinations below 2%, and the rollout was completed two weeks ahead of schedule.

The Automated Grading Assistant handled 10 K student essays per day with 94% rubric alignment. Priya combined RoBERTa fine‑tuning with a lightweight FastAPI service and orchestrated everything on Kubernetes, achieving zero downtime during peak exam periods.

Priya’s Legal Contract Review Bot extracted obligations and risk clauses with 89% precision. She used a legal‑specific transformer (LegalBERT) and integrated it with a PostgreSQL vector store for fast similarity search. The client praised the intuitive UI and the audit logs for compliance.

The Media Content Tagger accurately labeled 1.2 M video frames using EfficientNet‑B3. While the model hit 78% mAP, we noticed slower batch inference on older GPUs; Priya later added ONNX export to improve throughput. Still, the project met all delivery dates.

Priya’s Fraud Detection Dashboard identified anomalous transactions with 85% recall, but the false‑positive rate hovered around 14%, causing extra manual review work. She was responsive to feedback and proposed a post‑processing rule engine to tighten precision, which we plan to implement next quarter.

The Volunteer Matchmaking Platform used a dual‑encoder architecture (SBERT) to pair volunteers with opportunities. Matching relevance improved by 27% and the system handled spikes during disaster response without degradation. Priya’s thorough testing and clear API docs were especially appreciated.

Predictive Maintenance for Assembly Lines ran on edge devices with a TinyML model (ONNX‑converted LSTM). Downtime dropped 22% in the first three months. Priya set up a robust monitoring stack with Prometheus and Grafana, making model drift detection effortless.

The Dynamic Pricing Engine combined time‑series forecasting (Prophet) with a reinforcement‑learning policy. Revenue per available room rose 9% YoY. Priya’s modular codebase allowed the client’s data science team to experiment with new features without touching production pipelines.
